subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 1: Vocabulary and Grammar (daily routines)
outcomes: I can say and write ten daily routines.
I can say what I do and don't do with I / We and don't.

tf.s: We get up in the morning.
tf.why: Yes! We get up when the day starts.

tf.s: Go to bed is the first routine of the day.
tf.why: Go to bed is the last routine. Get up is the first.

tf.s: We use don't to say no: I don't play.
tf.why: Great! Don't comes before the verb.

tf.s: The sentence I play don't is correct.
tf.why: Don't comes before the verb: I don't play.

tf.s: Have breakfast means eat in the morning.
We have dinner at school in the morning.

tf.why: It's is the short way to say It is.

tf.s: We say do homework, not have homework.
tf.why: Well done! The routine is do homework.

tf.s: A red cross in a picture means a yes sentence.
tf.why: A red cross means no, so we use don't.

tf.s: We can say We have lunch. and We don't have lunch.
tf.why: One is yes and one is no.

boxes.q: A boy stretches and yawns. Which routine is it?
boxes.why: We stretch and yawn when we get up.
Dinner is a meal we eat.
We use don't before the verb.

boxes.q: A boy is sleeping at night. Which routine is it?
boxes.why: At night we go to bed.

boxes.q: Which routine do we do in the art room?
boxes.why: We paint and draw in art lessons.

boxes.q: Picture: tennis with a red cross. Which sentence?

boxes.why: It's is short for It is.

hunt.q: Meal in the middle of the day

mcq.q: Which word do we use to say no?
Which routine is NOT a meal?
Which routine do we do first in the day?
Which routine is about eating eggs and bread in the morning?
Order the words: breakfast / We / have
mcq.why: I or We comes first, then the verb.

mcq.q: Picture: dinner with a red cross. Which sentence?
mcq.why: The cross means no: I don't have dinner.
Don't comes before the verb play.

mcq.q: Which routines are in the right order for a day?
o: get up, have breakfast, go to school
go to bed, get up, have lunch
have dinner, get up, go to school
go to school, get up, have breakfast
mcq.why: We get up, eat breakfast, then go to school.

mcq.q: The chant says I don't play. Ali plays every day. What can Ali say?
mcq.why: Ali plays, so his sentence has no don't.

mcq.q: Which sentence is about something you do at home in the afternoon?
mcq.why: We do homework at home after school.
